senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. כָּוָה)to be dim (of sight, light).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65:4">Gen. R. s. 65</cite> <he>כָּהוּ עיניו</he> his eyes grew dim.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65:10">Ib.</cite> <he>שיִכְהוּ עיניו</he> that his eye-sight shall fail.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 24b">Kidd. 24ᵇ</cite> <sub>…</sub> <he>הכהו וכָהֲתָה</he> if the master struck him on his eye, and it grew dim; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>כָּהוּי</he>, f. <he>כָּהוּיָה</he>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 24b:12">Ib.</cite> <he>הרי שהיתה עינו כ׳ וכ׳</he> if his eye-sight was dim, and he (the master) made him perfectly blind.

senses.gloss: (of color) to be dull, v. כֵּהֶה. [Tosef. Erub. XI (VIII), 8; Tanḥ. Noah 9, v. כָּחַח.]
to grow duller, to be shaded. Sifra Thazr., Neg., Par. 2, ch. II אם העז וכ׳ if the spot grew brighter and grew duller again; a. fr.—2) to declare doubtful.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 4:11">Neg. IV, 11</cite> <he>ר׳ י׳ כ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="K00151"><he>כֵּהֶה</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="K00155">same</cite>. Y. Shebu. I, 32ᵈ, v. <cite ref="K00151"><he>כֵּהֶה</he></cite>.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 11:5">Neg. XI, 5</cite> <he>ה׳ בתחלה</he> if the suspicious spot grew fainter at once (before the ordered isolation was begun); <he>ה׳ בראשון</he> if it grew faint in the first week; Tosef. ib. V, 6 quot. in R. S. to Neg. l. c. (ed. Zuck. <he>כהה כתחלה</he>, oth. ed. only <he>כתחלה</he>, corr. acc.); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to make dim. Gen. R. l. c. הריני מַכְהֶה וכ׳ I will make his eye-sight dim.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 601">Yalk. Ruth 601</cite> <he>ייסורין מַכְהִין וכ׳ …</he> sufferings of poverty dim men’s eyes.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 14:1">Pesik. R. s. 14</cite> <he>מכהה גלגל חמה</he> dimmed (outshone) the sun in brightness; Pesik. Parah, p. 37ᵃ <he>שיַכְהֶה</he>; a. e.
